label: Variants
description: Basic item with title and description. Best for the 3 row variants stacked for comparison, default, outline and muted, as text only rows with no media or actions.

label: Icon & Actions
description: Items with icon media and action buttons. Best for notification channel rows at the default size, each a leading icon and 1 button, outline Configure or filled Enable.

label: User Follow
description: User item with avatar, info, and follow button. Best for compact people rows with a photo and job title that show the follow button in both states, Follow and Following.

label: Navigation Links
description: Clickable navigation items with icons and chevron. Best for account menu links, Profile, Security and Billing, where each whole row is an anchor and separators divide them.

label: Status Badges
description: Item group with status badges. Best for team presence rows in a spaced group, each with a photo, a role and an Online, Away or Offline badge.

label: File Rows
description: File items with icon media, size, and actions. Best for file rows with size and last update, a Final, Draft or Review badge and an Open button on each.

label: Keyboard Shortcuts
description: Items with keyboard shortcuts. Best for a narrow command menu of 5 link rows, each an icon and label with its key combination in a Kbd on the right.

label: Small Count Badges
description: Small-size items with badges. Best for mailbox folder links from Inbox to Trash in a narrow column, with a rounded count badge on Inbox and Drafts only.

label: Team Roles
description: Team members with roles and multiple actions. Best for member rows with email under the name, a role badge and a dots menu of Change Role, View Profile and Remove.

label: Header & Footer
description: Item with header and footer sections. Best for a narrow project card: kind label and In Progress badge on top, avatar stack and a 65% progress bar below.

label: Integrations
description: Integration items with connect actions. Best for data source rows where linked services show a Connected badge and the rest offer a Connect button.

label: Activity Feed
description: Activity feed items with avatars and actions. Best for a team log of deploys, merges and issues: a small photo, the person, a colored verb badge, the target and a relative time.
